hgsoc_pt01_brca1_mut_olaparib_responder.title: Patient HGSOC-01: Advanced HGSOC with Germline BRCA1 Deleterious Mutation and Olaparib Sensitivity
hgsoc_pt01_brca1_mut_olaparib_responder.citation: SOLO-1 Trial; Moore et al. (2018) NEJM; Robson et al. (2017) NEJM

clinical_history.primary_driver: Germline BRCA1 c.5266dupC mutation, loss of heterozygosity, universal TP53 missense
clinical_history.hospital_treatment: Carboplatin + Paclitaxel chemotherapy followed by Olaparib maintenance
clinical_history.real_world_outcome: Exceptional long-term remission, progression-free survival >56.0 months (Cured / Durable Remission)
clinical_history.known_resistance_mechanism: Severe homologous recombination repair failure results in persistent lethal double-strand breaks upon PARP1 catalytic inhibition and DNA entrapment

hgsoc_pt02_brca_reversion_acquired_parp_.title: Patient HGSOC-02: Relapsed HGSOC with Acquired Intragenic BRCA1 Reversion Mutation
hgsoc_pt02_brca_reversion_acquired_parp_.citation: Norquist et al. (2018) Cancer Discovery; Christie et al. (2017) JCO; Lin et al. (2019) CCR

clinical_history.primary_driver: Secondary in-frame deletion restoring BRCA1 reading frame, TP53 mut
clinical_history.real_world_outcome: Rapid disease progression at 4.4 months, widespread peritoneal carcinomatosis, death at 12.1 months
clinical_history.known_resistance_mechanism: Genetic reversion mutation restores functional RAD51-mediated homologous recombination, neutralizing PARP entrapment and platinum crosslinks

hgsoc_pt03_ccne1_amplified_platinum_refr.title: Patient HGSOC-03: Primary Refractory HGSOC with Focal CCNE1 Genomic Amplification
hgsoc_pt03_ccne1_amplified_platinum_refr.citation: TCGA-OV (Nature 2011); Etemadmoghadam et al. (2013) CCR; Nakayama et al. (2010) Cancer

clinical_history.primary_driver: High-level CCNE1 copy number amplification, wild-type BRCA1/2, mutant TP53
clinical_history.real_world_outcome: Primary chemo-refractory, progression during first-line therapy at 2.4 months, death at 6.1 months
clinical_history.known_resistance_mechanism: Cyclin E1 hyperactivation forces premature S-phase entry, hyperactivates CDK2, and overrides platinum-induced replication fork stalling

hgsoc_pt04_brca_wt_hrd_positive_nirapari.title: Patient HGSOC-04: BRCA-Wild-Type but Genomic Scar HRD-Positive High Niraparib Sensitivity
hgsoc_pt04_brca_wt_hrd_positive_nirapari.citation: PRIMA Trial; González-Martín et al. (2019) NEJM; Mirza et al. (2016) NEJM

clinical_history.primary_driver: RAD51C promoter hypermethylation, functional HR deficiency, intact BRCA1/2 coding
clinical_history.real_world_outcome: PFS 21.9 months (vs 10.4 mo placebo), durable clinical remission
clinical_history.known_resistance_mechanism: Epigenetic shutdown of the homologous recombination machinery creates synthetic lethal vulnerability identical to BRCA mutations

hgsoc_pt05_akt2_amplified_mcl1_dependent.title: Patient HGSOC-05: Platinum-Resistant Recurrent HGSOC with Focal AKT2 Amplification and High MCL-1
hgsoc_pt05_akt2_amplified_mcl1_dependent.citation: AURELIA Trial; Pujade-Lauraine et al. (2014) JCO; TCGA-OV Consortium; Bell et al. (2011)

clinical_history.primary_driver: Focal 19q13.2 AKT2 genomic amplification, secondary STAT3 activation
clinical_history.real_world_outcome: Disease progression at 4.8 months, malignant bowel obstruction, death at 9.6 months
clinical_history.known_resistance_mechanism: AKT2 amplicon hyperactivates downstream mTOR and phosphorylates BAD while maintaining massive MCL-1 expression, suppressing paclitaxel taxane-induced mitotic catastrophe

hgsoc_pt06_pi3k_pten_null_refractory.title: Patient HGSOC-06: Ovarian Carcinoma with Activating PIK3CA Mutation and Biallelic PTEN Loss
hgsoc_pt06_pi3k_pten_null_refractory.citation: Anglesio et al. (2013) J Pathol; TCGA-OV; Cheasley et al. (2019) Clin Cancer Res

clinical_history.primary_driver: Activating PIK3CA E545K mutation + homozygous PTEN genomic deletion
clinical_history.real_world_outcome: Early failure at 3.0 months, rapid malignant ascites accumulation, death at 7.8 months
clinical_history.known_resistance_mechanism: Synergistic PI3K/PTEN pathway activation continuously stabilizes XIAP, MCL-1, and MDM2, insulating the cell against both DNA adducts and microtubule stabilizers

hgsoc_pt07_bevacizumab_refractory_vegf_a.title: Patient HGSOC-07: Advanced Metastatic HGSOC with Acquired Bevacizumab Anti-Angiogenic Bypass
hgsoc_pt07_bevacizumab_refractory_vegf_a.citation: GOG-0218 Trial; Burger et al. (2011) NEJM; Backen et al. (2014) CCR; TCGA-OV

clinical_history.subtype: High-Grade Serous Ovarian Carcinoma with High-Volume Ascites
clinical_history.primary_driver: High autocrine VEGF/EGFR loops, hypoxia-driven STAT3 and NF-kB upregulation
clinical_history.real_world_outcome: Relapse at 5.5 months with recurrent symptomatic peritoneal ascites, death at 11.0 months
clinical_history.known_resistance_mechanism: Severe intra-tumoral hypoxia triggers alternate paracrine angiogenic survival signaling through STAT3 and NF-kB, rendering VEGF-A blockade ineffective

hgsoc_pt08_pan_refractory_ccne1_akt2_p53.title: Patient HGSOC-08: Ultra-Aggressive Pan-Refractory HGSOC with CCNE1 and AKT2 Co-Amplification
hgsoc_pt08_pan_refractory_ccne1_akt2_p53.citation: Stronach et al. (2011) Cancer Res; TCGA-OV Consortium; Patch et al. (2015) Nature

clinical_history.subtype: Pan-Refractory Triplet-Hit (CCNE1 amp + AKT2 amp + TP53 null) HGSOC
clinical_history.primary_driver: Concurrent CCNE1 amplification, AKT2 amplification, and TP53 null mutation
clinical_history.real_world_outcome: Primary treatment failure, explosive abdominal dissemination at 1.9 months, death at 4.2 months
clinical_history.known_resistance_mechanism: Simultaneous hyperactivation of CDK2 and AKT2 creates an impenetrable dual survival lock: unrestricted S-phase progression combined with maximal MCL-1/BCL-xL anti-apoptotic buffering
